reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: §12.3 expressly negates any exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment by Customer and preserves freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell, use any product/service and operate in any field or territory — this meets the preferred position (no restriction on Customer).
§12.4 restricts only Vendor from developing a competing service, which per the detection guidance is acceptable and benefits our side; correctly not flagged.
No redline or comment proposed, which is appropriate for a compliant finding; deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction binds Customer.
Rationale accurately cites the relevant provisions and notes the related §2.1/§24 provisions without double-flagging.
